title: Domestic Main Cabin Award Pricing Chart by Points Earned, Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Chart.** For a domestic Crestline Main Cabin round-trip award redeemed from Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements company points, the award earning measure is the points of every points accrual entry and every bonus entry posted to the agreement in the award earning window: the 12 calendar months up to and including the redemption date, each entry placed by its posting date. The award earning measure sets the award earning percentage:

| Award earning measure | Award earning percentage |
|---|---|
| 120000 points or more | 88 percent |
| 60000 points or more, and below 120000 | 94 percent |
| below 60000 points | 100 percent (the listed price) |

**How the percentage acts.** The award earning percentage multiplies the standard domestic award price, the tier's domestic Main Cabin round-trip award points. Where the price carries several such percentages, they are all applied together to the standard price, each divided by one hundred, and the product is rounded to the nearest whole point once.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Accruals of 55000 points and a bonus of 5000 points in the window: 60000 points, 94 percent.
- Accruals of 59999 points and no bonus: 100 percent.
- Accruals of 110000 points and bonuses of 10000 points: 120000 points, 88 percent.
- Redemptions and expiries do not reduce the measure; only accrual and bonus entries count.
- With 94 percent and no other percentage, a standard price of 1600 points becomes 1600 multiplied by 94 and divided by one hundred: 1504 points.
